title: The three-colour Rado numbers of ax + 3y = 3z (computer-assisted proof candidate)
description:
Computer-assisted proof candidate that R3(ax + 3y = 3z) = a3 + a2 + 7a + 1 for every integer a ≥ 4 with 3 not dividing a. This is the case b = 3 of Conjecture 1.1 of T. Ahmed, L. Zaman and C. Bright (arXiv:2505.12085); the lower bound is their Theorem 1.3, and this record contains a proof of the upper bound.

The record contains the proof (proof/proof.pdf and its LaTeX source), 126 propositional formulas with LRAT unsatisfiability certificates checked by lrat-check and cake_lpr, the generators and audit scripts, a mechanical check of the hand-proved parts, and SHA-256 sums of every file.

Status: not peer reviewed. The work was developed with substantial assistance from AI systems (Anthropic Claude and OpenAI GPT); see the README and the section on the use of AI tools in the proof.
